The '''baggage-robo''',<ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> also known as a '''baggage carrier''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] often found in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. These automatons could be hired to carry one's luggage from terminal to terminal.<ref name="HSLL" /> The simple automaton was classified as a [[Remote/Legends|remote]].<ref name="EGWT" />
